title: Bintulu language
description: Austronesian language spoken in Sarawak, Malaysia
extract: Bintulu or Vaie is an Austronesian language of Borneo. Robert Blust leaves it as an isolate within the North Sarawakan languages. Ethnologue notes that it might be closest to Baram within those languages.
